cases.prompt: There are 9 cartons. Each carton has 8 bulbs. 15 bulbs are removed. How many bulbs remain?
A desk has 3 boxes with 27 cards in each. 6 cards are received. How many cards are there now?
There are 12 baskets. Each basket holds 5 pears. 4 pears are sold. How many pears are left?
The storeroom has 10 jars with 13 screws in each. 17 screws are used. How many screws remain?
There are 6 crates. Each crate holds 8 lamps. Some lamps are missing. How many lamps remain?
